mapper.select: SELECT icam11_fee_deposit_id AS fee_deposit_id, icam11_icam_company_cd AS icam_company_code, icam11_icam_company_nm AS icam_company_name, icam11_fund_cd AS fund_code, icam11_fund_nm AS fund_name, icam11_cur_cd AS cur_code, icam11_consignment_nm AS consignment_name, icam11_deposit_id AS deposit_id, icam11_deposit_nm AS deposit_name, icam11_start_date AS start_date FROM ( SELECT icam11_fee_deposit.* , sys15_corp_nm as icam11_icam_company_nm , icam10_fund_nm as icam11_fund_nm , icam10_cur_cd as icam11_cur_cd , icam10_consignment_nm as icam11_consignment_nm , ast01_class_tree_nm as icam11_deposit_nm FROM icam11_fee_deposit LEFT OUTER JOIN ast01_class_tree ON ast01_class_tree_id = icam11_deposit_id LEFT OUTER JOIN sys15_corp ON ( sys15_company_id = icam11_company_id AND sys15_corp_cd = icam11_icam_company_cd ) INNER JOIN ( SELECT distinct icam10_icam_company_cd, icam10_fund_cd, icam10_fund_nm, icam10_cur_cd, icam10_consignment_nm FROM icam10_fee WHERE icam10_company_id = #{companyId} AND (icam10_icam_company_cd, icam10_fund_cd, icam10_std_date) IN ( SELECT icam10_icam_company_cd, icam10_fund_cd, MAX(icam10_std_date) FROM icam10_fee WHERE icam10_company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY icam10_icam_company_cd, icam10_fund_cd ) ) icam10 ON ( icam10_icam_company_cd = icam11_icam_company_cd AND icam10_fund_cd = icam11_fund_cd ) WHERE icam11_company_id = #{companyId} AND sys15_corp_id||'' LIKE #{corpIdStr} AND (icam11_icam_company_cd, icam11_fund_cd, icam11_start_date) IN ( SELECT icam11_icam_company_cd, icam11_fund_cd, MAX(icam11_start_date) FROM icam11_fee_deposit WHERE icam11_company_id = #{companyId} AND icam11_start_date <= f_today() GROUP BY icam11_icam_company_cd, icam11_fund_cd ) ) t WHERE UPPER(concat(icam11_icam_company_cd,icam11_icam_company_nm,icam11_fund_cd,icam11_fund_nm, icam11_cur_cd,icam11_consignment_nm,icam11_deposit_nm)) LIKE '%'||UPPER(#{searchText})||'%' ORDER BY icam11_icam_company_cd, icam11_fund_cd
